title: Alpha-Hederin alleviates psoriasiform skin inflammation by inhibiting NF-kappaB p65/CXCL2 Axis.
authors: He, Yuming; Liang, Honghui; Li, Rao; Liang, Chun-Ling; Liu, Huazhen; Qiu, Feifei; Dai, Zhenhua; Chen, Yuchao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究α-常春藤素通过抑制NF-κB p65/CXCL2轴缓解银屑病炎症，虽涉及分子对接和MD模拟验证小分子与p65蛋白结合，但核心是药物抗炎机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Psoriasis is a chronic, inflammatory and systemic skin disease. Currently, none of the treatment can effectively prevent the recurrent of psoriasis. alpha-Hederin is the main active ingredient of the traditional Chineses medicine Ivy, which has been proven to have anti-inflammatory effects. However, its effects on psoriasis and mechanisms of action remain unclear. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to investigate the effects of alpha-Hederin on murine psoriasis and its underlying mechanisms. METHODS: This study firstly evaluated the therapeutic effects of alpha-Hederin on psoriasis using imiquimod-induced psoriatic mice. H&E and Ki67 immunohistochemical stainings were used to observe the pathological changes and proliferation of the skin lesions. The expression of inflammatory cytokines in skin lesions was analyzed by ELISA. Subsequently, the network pharmacology was employed to predict the molecular targets of alpha-Hederin in psoriasis. CXCL2 expression and neutrophil infiltration in skin lesions were evaluated via immunohistochemical staining, immunofluorescent staining and flow cytometry. Finally, the effects of alpha-Hederin on NF-kappaB p65 pathway were evaluated. The binding of alpha-Hederin to NF-kappaB p65 protein was verified through molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, CETSA and DARTS. RESULTS: alpha-Hederin significantly improved IMQ-induced psoriasiform skin lesions and inflammation in mice. It also reduced the expression of CXCL2 and infiltration of CD11b(+)Ly6G(+) neutrophils in the skin of psoriatic mice. Importantly, administration of recombinant CXCL2 protein aggravated the skin lesions and increased CD11b(+)Ly6G(+) neutrophil infiltration in psoriatic mice previously treated with alpha-Hederin. Furthermore, alpha-Hederin inhibited the production of CXCL2 in HaCaT cells and migration of neutrophils to HaCaT cells. But these effects were completely reversed by the CU-T12-9, an NF-kappaB p65 agonist. Similarly, alpha-Hederin failed to further alleviate psoriasiform skin lesions and inflammation in mice treated with SC75741 (NF-kappaB p65 inhibitor). Finally, based on molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, CETSA and DARTS, NF-kappaB p65 was revealed as the direct target of alpha-Hederin in treating psoriasis. CONCLUSION: This study has provided the first evidence that alpha-Hederin may be a promising anti-psoriatic drug by inhibiting NF-kappaB p65/CXCL2 axis.
abstract_zh: 背景：银屑病是一种慢性、炎症性、系统性的皮肤病。目前，尚无任何治疗方法能有效预防银屑病的复发。α-常春藤素（alpha-Hederin）是传统中药常春藤的主要活性成分，已被证明具有抗炎作用。然而，其对银屑病的作用及机制尚不清楚。目的：本研究旨在探讨α-常春藤素对小鼠银屑病的影响及其潜在机制。方法：本研究首先使用咪喹莫特诱导的银屑病小鼠模型评估α-常春藤素的治疗效果。采用H&E染色和Ki67免疫组化染色观察皮损的病理变化和增殖情况。通过ELISA分析皮损中炎症细胞因子的表达。随后，利用网络药理学预测α-常春藤素在银屑病中的分子靶点。通过免疫组化染色、免疫荧光染色和流式细胞术评估皮损中CXCL2表达和中性粒细胞浸润。最后，评估α-常春藤素对NF-kappaB p65通路的影响。通过分子对接、分子动力学模拟、CETSA和DARTS验证α-常春藤素与NF-kappaB p65蛋白的结合。结果：α-常春藤素显著改善了IMQ诱导的小鼠银屑病样皮损和炎症。它还降低了银屑病小鼠皮肤中CXCL2的表达和CD11b(+)Ly6G(+)中性粒细胞的浸润。重要的是，给予重组CXCL2蛋白加重了先前经α-常春藤素处理的银屑病小鼠的皮损，并增加了CD11b(+)Ly6G(+)中性粒细胞的浸润。此外，α-常春藤素抑制了HaCaT细胞中CXCL2的产生以及中性粒细胞向HaCaT细胞的迁移。但这些效应被NF-kappaB p65激动剂CU-T12-9完全逆转。同样，α-常春藤素在经SC75741（NF-kappaB p65抑制剂）处理的小鼠中未能进一步减轻银屑病样皮损和炎症。最后，基于分子对接、分子动力学模拟、CETSA和DARTS，NF-kappaB p65被揭示为α-常春藤素治疗银屑病的直接靶点。结论：本研究首次提供证据表明，α-常春藤素可能通过抑制NF-kappaB p65/CXCL2轴成为一种有前景的抗银屑病药物。
